_readme: Course collectibles. The ball marker is the 'I played here' collectible and the ONLY tiered item (tier = best score at the course, see TIERS in game.ts). Patch, pitch marker, bag tag and pin are per-course achievements with no tiers. `default` is every course's set; `courses.<courseId>` customizes one course. Read by the app, `npm run art:prompts` and `npm run art:specs`. Rule types: roundsAtCourse{count}, birdieAtCourse, birdieOnHole{hole}, parOrBetterOnHole{hole}, parOrBetterOnHardestHole, birdieOnParFive, scoreBelowAtCourse{score}, tierAtCourse{tier}. Kinds (art shape): ball-marker, bag-tag, pitch-marker, patch, pin.

default.name: Pin
default.howToEarn: Par or better on the #1 handicap hole
